name: ThreadTabs
label: Thread tabs
description: The strip of open chat sessions: pill tabs with status dots and hover-revealed close buttons, a new-tab action, and animated enter and exit.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The open tabs, in display order. A tab added between renders glides open in place; a removed one folds away while its neighbours slide over.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Id of the tab on stage. Its pill renders filled and carries `aria-current`.

props.name: onTabSelect
props.description: Fires with the clicked tab's id.

props.name: onTabClose
props.description: Fires with the tab's id when its close button is pressed, or Delete lands on the focused tab. The close affordance renders only when this is given.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Spoken text for each tab status, read after the tab's label; the dot itself is decorative. Merged over the English defaults (Working, Unread, Needs input, Failed).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description:
Accessible name for a tab's close button. A string is followed by a colon
and the tab's label ("Close thread: Q3 plan"); a function is given the
label and returns the whole name, so a translation can put the label where
its grammar needs it.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Fires when the trailing new-tab button is pressed. The button renders only when this is given.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the new-tab button.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the tab strip.
